lines.1: We believe that good treatment begins with good understanding.
lines.2: That an informed patient makes better decisions.
lines.3: That prevention deserves as much attention as repair.
lines.4: That rigour is not a luxury, but a clinical responsibility.
lines.5: And that trust is built through clarity.

intro.label: The Studio
intro.title: A dental studio designed to slow down, understand and plan better.
intro.body: De Facto Dental Studio was designed to offer a calmer, more structured and more personalized experience. The space, the clinical approach and the digital tools come together to create continuity between analysis, decision and treatment.

pourquoi.label: Why De Facto exists
pourquoi.title: Dr Ramdani's intention
pourquoi.body: De Facto Dental Studio grew out of Dr Ramdani's intention to create a different kind of care setting: a calm, precise and reassuring environment where the patient can be heard, understood and guided with clarity.
pourquoi.body2: The goal is not only to treat a tooth or respond to a symptom. The goal is to take the time to understand the patient's complete situation, explain what has been observed, plan care with judgment and set the right priorities.
pourquoi.body3: At De Facto, time, listening, precision and continuity are not details. They are the conditions for care that is better understood, better planned and more durable.
pourquoi.body4: The studio was designed to put the clinical relationship back at the centre of the experience: a place where technology supports the dentist's judgment without replacing it, and where every decision is made with measure.

philosophie.label: Clinical philosophy
philosophie.title: Understand before intervening
philosophie.body: Our philosophy rests on a simple idea: every treatment must fit within a global understanding of the patient. Before intervening, we seek to understand the risks, priorities, expectations and limits specific to each situation.

espace.label: The space
espace.title: A space designed to slow the pace
espace.body: The studio environment was designed to create a calmer, clearer and more human experience. Each zone — reception, clinical room, laboratory and discussion area — supports the same idea: take the time to do things well.

faq.label: Resources
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions. For anything else, our team is reachable directly.
faq.q1: Can I come in just for an emergency?
faq.a1: Yes, emergencies can be assessed based on availability. The goal of an emergency appointment is to assess the situation, provide relief when possible and determine next steps. A complete examination may be recommended afterward depending on the context.
faq.q2: Is a complete examination required for new patients?
faq.a2: To establish a structured clinical relationship and propose appropriate care, a complete examination is generally recommended for new patients. Some emergencies may, however, require a targeted assessment first.
faq.q3: How long does the first visit take?
faq.a3: For a complete examination alone, plan for 30 to 45 minutes. If a cleaning is combined with the same appointment, plan for at least 1 hour 15 minutes, depending on the clinical situation.
faq.a4: Not automatically. The cleaning may be performed during a combined or separate appointment depending on available time, gum condition, the amount of buildup and clinical needs.
faq.a5: We can assist you in transmitting certain information or estimates depending on the available systems. Coverage, limits and any uncovered balances remain the patient's responsibility.
faq.a6: Some care can be offered to children depending on age, cooperation and the clinical situation. When necessary, an appropriate referral may be recommended.
faq.a7: Yes, certain alignment cases can be assessed. When the situation falls outside appropriate indications, an orthodontic referral may be recommended.
faq.q8: Do you perform root canal treatments?
faq.a8: Certain endodontic treatments can be assessed or performed depending on the situation. Complex cases may be referred to an endodontic specialist.
faq.a9: Yes. When a situation falls outside the scope of treatment offered at the studio, we coordinate the referral to an appropriate specialist.
faq.q10: Will I receive a treatment plan?
faq.a10: Depending on the situation, a plan may be discussed immediately or presented at a separate appointment called the oral health portrait.
faq.q11: Can I send my radiographs in advance?
faq.a11: Yes, if you have recent radiographs or relevant documents, they can be sent to the team before or after booking an appointment.
faq.ctaBody: Our team responds to inquiries by phone or through the contact form.

sections.title: Information collected
sections.body: We collect the information needed for your care: identification, contact details, medical and dental information relevant to the safety and quality of care.

sections.title: Use of information
sections.body: Your information is used to organize appointments, maintain the clinical record, deliver care, follow up and communicate as needed for your care.

sections.title: Sharing of information
sections.body: Your information is only shared when necessary for care, for a referral to another professional, for collaboration with the laboratory, or when required by law.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: Reasonable technical and organizational measures are in place to protect your information against loss, unauthorized access, modification or unintended disclosure.

sections.title: Access and correction
sections.body: You may request access to your information or correction of inaccurate details. An identity check may be required before processing the request.

sections.title: Consent
sections.body: Your consent is required to transmit certain information or documents (specialist referral, transmission to the laboratory, electronic communications). You may withdraw your consent for purposes not essential to care.

sections.title: Electronic communication
sections.body: Communications by email, SMS or web form may involve risks inherent to digital transit. The information transmitted should be limited to what is necessary for the request. For particularly sensitive information, an in-person or phone exchange may be preferable.

sections.title: Person responsible for the protection of personal information
sections.body: For any question regarding privacy, access to or correction of your personal information, or data security, you may contact the De Facto Dental Studio's person responsible for the protection of personal information by phone or email. De Facto Dental Studio operates under the laws applicable in Quebec and Canada, in particular the Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector (Law 25) and PIPEDA at the federal level.

philosophie.label: Philosophy
philosophie.title: Technology in service of predictability
philosophie.body: Our laboratory uses recognized equipment, rigorous protocols and materials approved by Health Canada when required. Technology is not an end in itself: it supports craftsmanship, communication and consistency of outcomes.

engagement.label: Commitment to referring professionals
engagement.title: Respecting the professional-patient relationship
engagement.body1: When a patient is sent to De Facto for shade selection, photographic documentation or a laboratory-related service, they remain the patient of the referring professional.
engagement.body2: To avoid any ambiguity, De Facto can provide a declaration confirming that the patient is not registered at De Facto Dental Studio for a defined period, when the situation warrants it.
engagement.body3: This measure aims to protect the relationship of trust between the referring professional, their patient and our laboratory.

1.title: Constant communication

2.title: Rigorous protocols and traceability
2.body: Each case is backed by a technical sheet, material traceability and documentation of the relevant steps.

3.title: Technology in service of craftsmanship
3.body: Digital equipment, printing, milling and controlled protocols in service of clinical precision.

4.title: Technical and clinical supervision
4.body: A technician and a supervising dentist take part in verifying the important steps of production.

services.label: Services
services.title: Services offered
services.intro: A complete range of restorations, prostheses, splints, retainers and planning aids, offered to studio patients and referring professionals.

items: Single-unit restorations (crown, inlay, veneer, bonded partial restoration)
